jobs.text: Legend says, Hanu-maan once tore the top off this mountain... and flew it across India.
This is Drona giri, in Uttaraakhand. It stands over seven thousand metres tall.
In the Raamaayan, Lakshman is badly wounded, in the war at Lanka.
Only herbs from a Himalayan mountain can save him. So Hanu-maan is sent to bring them.
But when he arrives, he can't tell which herb is which.
So he grows as big as a mountain, grabs the peak... and tears it off.
Even just the top kilometre of a mountain like this would weigh around two point eight billion tonnes.
That's more than five times the weight of every human on Earth.
Then he carries it about two thousand three hundred kilometres to Lanka, in a single night.
To do that in ten hours, he'd have to fly at around two hundred and thirty kilometres an hour, with a mountain in his hand.
The herbs work, and Lakshman wakes up.
And to this day, many people in Drona giri village don't worship Hanu-maan, because they believe he took their sacred mountain.
Follow for more legends, at real scale.
